# Mumla for Mac 1.0.1 (51) - Meeting Library Beta
## Changed
- Meetings now opens on a dated library instead of recording setup. Each row is one complete meeting, with its title, time, duration, state and text preview. - Search locally across meeting titles, transcript text, sources and speaker names. Open a result with one click and return without losing your search. - Wide windows keep the meeting list beside the transcript. Compact windows give the document its full available width and a clear All meetings button. - Copy transcript and Export stay above the transcript. They always include the complete meeting, even when the visible passages are filtered. Export supports plain text, Markdown and JSON. - New meeting opens recording setup explicitly. Browsing saved meetings does not stop a recording; Current meeting returns to its live controls.
Classic and Native styles are both supported. Existing recordings, dictionary, settings, downloaded models and on-device transcription are unchanged. No cloud provider, new data-sharing behavior or audio-capture permissions are added.
## Install And Test
Choose Check for Updates in the direct Mac app, or quit Mumla and replace it with the downloaded notarized app. Avoid running multiple Mumla copies at once.
Open Meetings, search for a title or a word spoken near the end of a meeting, and open the result. Try Copy transcript while searching within the document: the clipboard should still contain every passage. Check export and going back to the same search results. Try both styles at compact and wide window sizes.
The Swift suite executes 365 tests with nine existing optional model/hardware skips and no failures. The Mac app and UI-test runner compile, and isolated synthetic interaction checks cover search, open/back, copy feedback, export choices and browsing during recording in both appearances and styles. Automated Mac UI-runner execution remains unverified because UI Automation permission was not granted. No production recordings were used or changed during verification.
Real-call audio quality, capture permissions/routing, privacy traffic auditing and live updater replacement remain target-Mac acceptance checks. Meetings remain an experimental beta requiring Apple silicon, macOS 14.2 or later and participants' consent. This is not a new iOS or sandboxed Mac TestFlight build.

# Mumla for Mac 1.0.1 (50) - Classic and Native Styles Beta
## Changed
- Choose Classic or Native in Settings, independently of System, Light or Dark appearance. Existing installations keep Classic by default. - Native uses a Mac sidebar, system typography and platform controls. Supported systems use glass materials, with material fallbacks on older macOS versions. - The recording overlay, meeting views, settings and shared dialogs follow the selected style. Switching back restores Classic's recorder and title bar. - Style changes do not restart recording services, clear history, change audio permissions or alter transcription and text-formatting preferences. - Pressing the DJI mic button while an app update is being installed is now a no-op, including when Secure Input is enabled. Secure Input remains protected.
Existing live meetings, speaker correction, dictation and paste behavior remain. This release adds no cloud provider or new data-sharing feature. Models continue to run locally. The style preference stays on this device.
## Install And Test
Choose Check for Updates in the direct Mac app, or quit Mumla and replace it with the downloaded notarized app. History, dictionary, settings and downloaded models are preserved. Avoid running multiple copies of Mumla simultaneously.
In Settings, switch between Classic and Native, then try System, Light and Dark. Check the recorder, compact overlay, meetings, history and settings. Confirm that the style persists after relaunch and that recordings and model preferences stay unchanged. Meetings still require Apple silicon and macOS 14.2 or later, and participants' consent.
The local Swift suite passes 359 tests with nine optional model/hardware skips. Release-helper tests pass (35 tests, 84 assertions). Mac app and UI-test targets compile; isolated test-app inspection covered both styles and compact layouts. Automated Mac UI execution is not verified because UI Automation access was not granted. Physical audio capture, paste permissions/routing, older-OS materials, traffic auditing and live updater replacement still need target-Mac acceptance. This remains an experimental prerelease, not a quality guarantee for real calls.

# Mumla for Mac 1.0.1 (49) - Meeting Speaker Alignment Beta
## Changed
- Live meeting speaker labels use the next available audio chunk before assigning words near a chunk boundary. This fixes a reproduced timing defect that could alternate one person's speech between a numbered remote speaker and the unassigned audio source. - Speaker timing remains stable when transcription retries a chunk. Final partial chunks and pause/resume drain pending speaker context without ending a resumable session or adding words to the transcript. - Words use their duration rather than a single midpoint for speaker alignment. Brief activity gaps do not unnecessarily split one voice. Overlapping voices and uncertain predictions remain unassigned, not silently merged. - The old "Them" fallback is now "Unassigned remote". It is an audio-source fallback, not an identified person. Existing custom speaker names are retained. - Click a passage's speaker label to assign that passage to an existing speaker from the same audio source. Other passages, transcript text and timing stay unchanged. Previous identities remain available to restore a correction.
Existing recordings are not automatically relabelled. This fixes demonstrated alignment defects; it does not guarantee that the acoustic model will identify every person correctly in a group call.
System audio + microphone remains the default, with explicit Start and Stop. Selected-app and microphone-only capture, pause/resume, live local Swedish transcription, playback/export and existing dictation/paste behavior are retained. No audio or text is uploaded by these changes. iOS and Mac TestFlight are unchanged.
## Install And Test
Choose Check for Updates in the direct Mac app, or quit Mumla and replace it with the downloaded notarized app. Existing history, dictionary, settings and models are preserved. Do not run production, development and TestFlight copies together.
Meetings require Apple silicon and macOS 14.2 or later. The optional speaker model must be installed for automatic speaker separation. Obtain participants' consent. System audio includes other apps' and browser tabs' output; choose a specific app for narrower capture. Headphones help avoid acoustic microphone bleed.
On a consented group call, check continuous speech across chunk boundaries, different people taking turns, returning speakers, pause/resume and the final words after Stop. Correct a single passage with its speaker selector, then confirm that other people and the words themselves are unchanged.
The local Swift suite completed 355 tests with nine optional model/hardware skips and no failures. Coverage includes a delayed speaker stream, actual bounded FluidAudio timeline queries, retries, overlap, track isolation, model failure, old history and scoped correction safety. The native app and UI-test target compiled; the isolated selector was checked in compact light/dark layouts. Automated Mac UI-test execution, acoustic speaker quality, real-call capture, permissions/routing, traffic auditing and live updater replacement remain target-Mac acceptance checks. This remains an experimental prerelease.
